execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Real full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partially measured coverage with recording tools; actual full entry retains per-function executable line and branch measurement

Exact supported core/dependency pins, clean sources, missing inputs, nonoverlapping project paths separate from west/config metadata, fresh outputs outside source/dependency roots including symlink aliases, and parseable wrong custom-settings archive; identity and archive hash bypass controls

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

suppression_scope: No final source-button policy. Keep vector frames/history/remainders and exactly one persistence owner; existing executable tests unchanged.
selected_workspace: Workspace selection uses tests/integration/workspace-env.sh to export the selected manifest's ZEPHYR_MODULES and explicit Zephyr package/base paths. A Zephyr symlink to a different cache must not select that cache's module providers. The owner test_workspace_env.py exercises actual selection with a poisoned ambient list, a cache symlink, module paths containing spaces, failed project discovery and an empty selection. The keep-ambient negative control must fail these assertions. Full integration retains all supported-core, role, persistence and invalid-DTS cases. No dependency is patched or required feature disabled.

source_capacity.option: CONFIG_ZMK_INPUT_VECTOR_ACCELERATION_MAX_SOURCES: default0 exact automatic count/minimum1; positive1..256 original global ID prefix with no remapping
source_capacity.storage: 24-byte history plus4-byte fallback remainders per instance/source, fixed state and target alignment retained
source_capacity.guards: Enabled listener and enabled referenced device; default and ALL child routes including disabled children; any vector instance
source_capacity.portable: source_bound_harness.c: every byte ID with limits1,2,256, two nodes, NULL and invalid unchanged lookup; existing driver/persistence/curve/remainder assertions remain
source_capacity.integration: source-bound/run.py: twelve profiles on both cores, high3/4 auto, low0/1 auto/2, full256, six named route rejects including exact prefix endpoints1/3, disabled listener/device acceptance, four guard mutants; each runtime profile same ELF three times with required completion and actual capacity assertion
source_capacity.original_control: source-bound/control-original.py requires the original driver to hit the named two-slot allocation assertion; classify separately from product results
source_capacity.selection: Canonical integration pins complete original plus source profiles; rejects argument/ambient focused selectors; standalone --profile is documented diagnostic only

integer_width.production: 32-bit arithmetic; independent wider oracles remain test-only
integer_width.contract: Vector products, normalized ratios, speed and saturated signed output use 32-bit arithmetic. Rare full-range ratios use bounded binary fractional division. Core clock parameters and last_report_time_ms are uint32 milliseconds; migrate external core callers by passing the low 32 bits of monotonic uptime. Histories remain valid across wrap for intervals at most 100 ms. An entire 2^32 ms of silence cannot be distinguished from a short interval.
integer_width.fixtures: test_vector_accel.c retains independent wide arithmetic references and gain/remainder/saturation cases, adds cancellation at signed limits and checks long gaps, backwards times and wrap continuity. test_vector_width.py rejects wide helpers in a 32-bit object.
integer_width.history_storage: uint16 time history, reachable 0..200 ms under 100 ms intervals and half decay; compile-time capacity guard; 24-byte stream layout guard; 12000 ordered frames against independent wide recurrence, all 0..100 ms intervals, wrap and long-gap/backwards resets with per-frame gain checks. Recompile public core callers; curve persistence layout and listener capacities are unchanged.
